english.text: Anywhere else in the world, this would be a fisherman's dream, rivers so abundant with fish they jump out of the water, and often right into the boat. But these are not the kind of fish that get anglers in the United States excited. They are known as Asian Carp and the explosion of their population in the Illinois River is a concern to large-river ecologist Kevin Irons.

jyutping: hai2 sai3 gaai3 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1，ni1 go3 wui5 hai6 jyu4 fu1 ge3 mung6 soeng2，ho4 lau4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 jyu4，keoi5 dei6 wui5 tiu3 ceot1 seoi2 min2，ji4 ce2 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tiu3 jap6 syun4 jap6 min6。daan6 hai6 ni1 di1 m4 hai6 ling6 mei5 gwok3 diu3 jyu2 ze2 hing1 fan5 ge3 jyu4。keoi5 dei6 bei6 cing1 wai4 aa3 zau1 lei5 jyu2，ji4 keoi5 dei6 hai2 ji1 lei6 nok6 ho4 ge3 sou3 loeng6 baau3 zaa3 hai6 daai6 jing4 ho4 lau4 sang1 taai3 hok6 gaa1 Kevin Irons ge3 jat1 go3 gwaan1 zyu3 dim2。
text: 喺世界其他地方，呢個會係漁夫嘅夢想，河流入面有好多魚，佢哋會跳出水面，而且通常會跳入船入面。但係呢啲唔係令美國釣魚者興奮嘅魚。佢哋被稱為亞洲鯉魚，而佢哋喺伊利諾河嘅數量爆炸係大型河流生態學家 Kevin Irons 嘅一個關注點。

text: 當你聽住一種應該齋係外語嘅歌，例如斯洛伐克文、馬其頓文、斯洛文尼亞文，聽到你由細識到大，甚至可以理解晒成個詞組嘅字，並會令到埋你個心暖啲。

english.text: But the bill must still be passed by the lower house and half of all state legislatures before it turns into law. That task may not be easy, given the staunch opposition of these parties and growing disquiet among other lawmakers.

I want to love, cherish and honor you all the days of my life. Wear this ring as a sign of our love and faithfulness: In the name of the Father and the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

text: 喺神面前，我當你係我嘅丈夫。我向你承諾會喺好同壞嘅日子，無論係病定健康，都會忠於你，直到死亡將我哋分開。我想喺我生命中嘅所有日子都愛、珍惜同敬重你。戴呢隻戒指，係我哋愛同忠誠嘅象徵：以父子同聖靈嘅名義。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 10th of August of 2025, here on Lulu Island. Just before midnight, I eat a yellow-green apple, whilst reserving the salty sushi-chorizo rice with nori sheets and bitter-melon mung-bean soup in the refrigerator for my morning meal, later. These recent days have been uncomfortable for me due to a bad cold: How anachronistic for such blue-sky sunny days! At Tim Hortons café, I have been joking with Michael the ufologist about Trekker things such as the "Live Long and Prosper!" Vulcan greeting, the Romulan greeting "Jolan tru!" for "May your day be filled with peace!" and the Klingon greeting "nuqneH?" for "What do you want?" Michael liked The Original Series, but none of the new ones, unlike I. He watched also movies with Shatner and Nimoy. Michael doesn't read sci-fi, but pseudoscience about UFOs. He's like my other friend Bratislav who looks for reality in UFOs. I, on the other hand, accept that sci-fi is irreality for understanding reality. Sci-fi in various languages is what I read and watch. I'm still agnostic about UFOs.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 8 jyut6 10 hou6，hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2。 ngaam1 ngaam1 bun3 je2 cin4，ngo5 sik6 zo2 go3 wong4 luk6 ping4 gwo2，tung4 si4 zoeng1 haam4 sau6 si1 hoeng1 coeng2 faan6 pui3 maai4 zi2 coi3 pin3 tung4 fu2 gwaa1 luk6 dau2 tong1 fong3 hai2 syut3 gwai6 dou6，dang2 ngo5 ci4 di1 ge3 zou2 caan1。 ne1 gei2 jat6 jan1 wai6 gam2 mou6 ji4 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6：deoi3 jyu1 gam3 laam4 tin1 ge3 cing4 tin1 lai4 gong2，zan1 hai6 gei2 m4 hap6 si4！ hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 jat1 zik6 tung4 fei1 dip2 hok6 gaa1 Michael gong2 siu3，gong2 gan2 Trekker ge3 je5，lai6 jyu4「coeng4 meng6 faan4 wing4！」 fo2 san4 man6 hau6，lo4 mou6 laan4 jan4 man6 hau6「Jolan tru！」 jan1 wai6「jyun6 nei5 ge3 jat6 zi2 cung1 mun5 ping4 on1！」 tung4 maai4 hak1 lam4 dung1 man4 ge3 man6 hau6 jyu5「 nuqneH？」 wai6 zo2「nei5 soeng2 jiu3 di1 me1？」 Michael zung1 ji3《jyun4 cong3 hai6 lit6》，daan6 hai6 mou5 jat1 tou3 san1 ge3，m4 ci5 ngo5。keoi5 zung6 tung4 saa1 dak6 naap6 tung4 nei4 mok6 ji1 jat1 cai4 tai2 gwo3 din6 jing2。 Michael m4 hai6 tai2 fo1 waan6，ji4 hai6 tai2 gwaan1 jyu1 fei1 dip2 ge3 ngai6 fo1 hok6。 keoi5 tung4 ngo5 ling6 jat1 go3 pang4 jau5 bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1 jat1 joeng6，keoi5 wui5 hai2 fei1 dip2 jap6 min6 wan2 jin6 sat6。 ling6 jat1 fong1 min6，ngo5 zip3 sau6 fo1 waan6 hai6 lei5 gaai2 jin6 sat6 ge3 fei1 jin6 sat6。 gok3 zung2 jyu5 jin4 ge3 fo1 waan6 pin3 hai6 ngo5 tai2 tung4 tai2 ge3 je5。 ngo5 deoi3 UFO zung6 hai6 mou4 zi1 ge3。
text: 今日係2025年8月10號，喺呢度露露島。 啱啱半夜前，我食咗個黃綠蘋果，同時將咸壽司香腸飯配埋紫菜片同苦瓜綠豆湯放喺雪櫃度，等我遲啲嘅早餐。 呢幾日因為感冒而對我嚟講好唔舒服：對於咁藍天嘅晴天嚟講，真係幾唔合時！ 喺Tim Hortons咖啡館，我一直同飛碟學家 Michael 講笑，講緊 Trekker 嘅嘢，例如「長命繁榮！」 火神問候，羅慕蘭人問候「Jolan tru！」 因為「願你嘅日子充滿平安！」 同埋克林冬文嘅問候語「 nuqneH？」 為咗「你想要啲咩？」 Michael 鍾意《原創系列》，但係冇一套新嘅，唔似我。佢仲同沙特納同尼莫伊一齊睇過電影。 Michael 唔係睇科幻，而係睇關於飛碟嘅偽科學。 佢同我另一個朋友布拉迪斯拉夫一樣，佢會喺飛碟入面搵現實。 另一方面，我接受科幻係理解現實嘅非現實。 各種語言嘅科幻片係我睇同睇嘅嘢。 我對UFO仲係無知嘅。
